title: European Family in Traditional 1930s Attire Outdoors, B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length group portrait showing five family members—an adult man and woman with three boys or young men—standing outside against a whitewashed wall and wooden door. The boys are dressed in suits with knickerbockers and knee-length shorts paired with wool socks, sturdy leather shoes, and flat caps. The father wears a wide-brimmed felt hat and a dark suit, while the mother stands on the left in a dress with a head covering. The photograph features deckled edges characteristic of mid-20th-century print processing.
